Undergraduate dissertation

Irrigation and food security among market gardeners

My undergraduate dissertation examines market gardeners’ production conditions and food security.

01

The starting question

Access to water affects the stability of market gardening output and growers’ food security. I studied this question in my undergraduate dissertation.

02

The approach

I conducted a survey and econometric analysis for my undergraduate dissertation in agricultural economics and farm management.

03

Interpretation & limitations

Numerical findings need to be checked against the dissertation before they are shared online. This overview covers the topic and method.

Work status

Undergraduate dissertation completed in 2023.
